mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a labor market so tight that wage inflation will soon accelerate, prompting the Fed to raise rates and depress equity valuations. This results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPI inflation remains below 2% over the next 6 months, indicating that wage pressures are not spilling over into broad price inflation.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows sharply (3-month change < -2%), it signals a supply shock that will reduce output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods following the INDPRO slowdown signal.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates (3-month change > 10%) and the federal funds rate is below 3%, it signals a housing-led demand boom that will boost economic growth and equity prices over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Housing starts growth reverts to below 5% in the month following the signal, indicating the boom was short-lived.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate (> 50 bps in 3 months) when the unemployment rate is already low (< 5%) signals a policy mistake that will choke off growth and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Fed immediately reverses course and cuts rates by > 25 bps within 1 month of the signal, indicating they recognize the policy mistake.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows sharply (3-month change < 100k) and the unemployment rate is already high (> 6%), it signals a labor market downturn that will weigh on consumer spending and equity prices over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Payroll growth immediately rebounds to > 200k in the month following the signal, indicating the slowdown was temporary.

mechanism_narrative: Real estate investment (RSAFS) growth accelerating faster than GDP growth over the past year signals overinvestment in housing that will soon reverse, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Housing investment growth slows sharply and reverts to below GDP growth within 6 months of the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the CPI inflation rate (> 1% in 3 months) when the federal funds rate is already above 4% signals that the Fed is behind the curve and will need to raise rates even higher, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Fed pauses its rate hiking cycle within 3 months of the signal, indicating that they believe inflation is under control.
